description: This file defines a class Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearAssign that implements the clearAssign() method for the Smarty templating engine, allowing the clearing of assigned template variables.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_ClearAssign
classes.description: A class providing the clearAssign() method to remove variables from Smarty templates.

methods.name: clearAssign
methods.description: Clears specified template variables from the given Smarty data object or template.
